experiment: Approach B V3.3 - from-scratch corrective-placement sampler (TaskCVAE scratch_all): S-control vs S-expanded
registered_before: any V3.3 sampler training, proposal outcome or teacher query
splits: TRAIN = training; VALIDATION = every decision in this milestone; exposed TEST = NOT used in V3.3 (no run planned); fresh cohort = preparation and cost pilot only

terms.M: top-M distinct destination proposals per eligible object (S1: top-M of the 64-draw Monte-Carlo marginal); NOT repair length
terms.K: number of ordered corrective relocations, K <= 3
terms.B: historic 4,096 complete-sequence cap; V3.3 uses exact exhaustive enumeration (no cap)
terms.positive_target: V3-grammar-legal assignment whose canonical endpoint has Y = 1 and with >= 1 physically verified X = 1 order (contracts.positive_assignments); all successful orders of one assignment = ONE target; X = 0 / Y = 0 / unknown never positive
terms.unknown: a missing / censored / unresolved X or Y is UNKNOWN, never a failure

hypothesis_H1: A randomly initialized TaskCVAE trained on all positive assignments of the expanded V3.2 snapshot (S-expanded) gives higher physically verified top-1 task success than the identical scratch TaskCVAE trained on the pre-expansion V3 snapshot (S-control), when both are paired with the same frozen D-expanded scorer, exhaustive M4 and the frozen V3.2 rule.

arms.reference_only: historical q2init_all s0 (Q2-pretrained then fine-tuned on V2 snapshot abf_v2_7d146b53e4b92fe4) + D-expanded s0, exhaustive M4: existing verified V3.2 VAL records; different initialization AND training data -> not a matched ablation

data_audit: DATA_AUDIT.json (2D: +879 unique positive assignments on 272 roots, +1,469 distinct actions, examples 7,591 -> 9,729; 3D: +854 on 254 roots, +1,066 actions, 4,782 -> 6,807; 0 control positives lost; 0 holdout rows changed; 0 families in two splits)

controlled_variables.architecture: placement.TaskCVAE (hidden 128, z 8, task branch on; task input unchanged)
controlled_variables.initialization: random (torch.manual_seed(seed) then construction on CPU); NO init_from_q2, no pretrained load, no resume; init state sha256 must be equal across arms per seed
controlled_variables.input_normalization: Q2 TRAIN feature scaler data/q2_<dom>/scalers.json (deterministic normalization constants, not model weights; sha256 2d 884b3567..., 3d 36a94926...)
controlled_variables.supervision: assign = all; one example per (object, destination) action of each target; context = original scene + task features; static legal mask
controlled_variables.weighting: unchanged repair_data rule: each TRAIN root with >= 1 positive has total weight 1 (1/|A_i| per assignment x 1/|A| per action), normalized to mean 1; a newly positive root enters the expanded arm with the same rule (2D +25 roots, 3D +22)
controlled_variables.objective: weighted negative conditional ELBO (reconstruction + beta KL), beta_max 1.0, warm-up over the first 10 evaluations
controlled_variables.budget: FIXED optimizer steps per domain, equal for both arms = 80 epochs of the S-control data: 2D 2,400 steps (eval every 30), 3D 1,520 steps (eval every 19); batches = slices of seeded permutations of the arm's own examples; no early stopping
controlled_variables.checkpoint: minimum VALIDATION weighted negative ELBO on the identical base-snapshot VAL targets (2D 860 examples / 404 roots, 3D 455 / 219)
controlled_variables.fits: 2 domains x 2 arms x 3 seeds = 12 (smoke seed 0 reused)

smoke_gate: seed 0 both arms per domain: finite train/VAL ELBO, equal init sha, legal masks intact, non-empty targets. Budget rule (VAL ELBO only, before any proposal or physical outcome): if either arm's best VAL ELBO is at the final evaluation, double the step budget for BOTH arms in that domain and re-run the smoke.

frozen_evaluation.scorer: frozen V3.2 D-expanded s0 (2d 0fa126da..., 3d c02afcbc...), never retrained; travel head p3 cost_s0 (unused by the rule)
frozen_evaluation.sampling: S1 top-M of 64 MC latent draws, per-root torch generator seed 0 (identical proposal RNG stream for every sampler), same device (girish CUDA) for every sampler
frozen_evaluation.teachers: unchanged 2D/3D X/Y teachers on parity-passed hosts (laptop CPU, girish CPU)

screening_teacher_free: VAL proposal-level known-success coverage at M4 (diagnostic M5/M6): a VAL task root is covered if some KNOWN positive assignment (base snapshot VAL labels + V3.2 VAL verify caches) has every action inside the top-M proposal sets; K1/K2/K3 separate; plus unique proposals, NONE/no-op roots and weighted VAL ELBO. Diagnostic only (known labels are incomplete; collected mostly from q2init proposals).
physical_pilot: sampler seed 0 of both arms on ALL VAL roots (2D 751, 3D 364), D-expanded s0, exhaustive M4, every selected repair physically verified.
pilot_go_no_go: per domain, Delta = S-expanded - S-control verified task success (paired root bootstrap, 2,000): STOP_NULL (no seeds 1-2 physical evaluation) if Delta <= 0 AND CI95 upper < +2.0 points; otherwise evaluate sampler seeds 1 and 2 of both arms.
primary_analysis: per domain, 3 sampler seeds (if not stopped): per-root average over seeds, paired root-cluster bootstrap (2,000) of S-expanded - S-control on VAL task roots (2D 413, 3D 220); secondary: K1/K2/K3, correct NONE abstention, correct no-op, calibration (selected mean p11 - verified rate), coverage vs ranking failures.
decision_rule: SUPPORTED if task Delta CI95 lower > 0 AND NONE-abstention Delta point estimate >= -3.0 points; HARMFUL if task Delta CI95 upper < 0; otherwise NULL (or NULL_PILOT if stopped after the pilot).
final_scratch_configuration: the arm with the higher seed-mean VAL task success, unless its seed-mean correct NONE abstention is > 3.0 points below the other arm's (then the other arm); deployed sampler seed = 0 (pre-declared, not best-of-seeds).
robustness: only if the primary decision is SUPPORTED or HARMFUL: sampler seed 0 of BOTH arms re-scored with D-expanded s1 and s2 (paired, physically verified).
production_reference: q2init_all s0 + D-expanded s0 exhaustive M4 on the same VAL roots (existing verified V3.2 E records); labelled different-initialization/different-data reference; production is NOT replaced automatically - trade-off reported for the user.
not_in_scope: full fresh-cohort generation (needs an authorized CPU budget)

compute_policy.workers: dynamic by measured free RAM, load and temperature; one thread per teacher worker; nice 10; leave >= 4 CPU threads free on girish
